chunks: And by this chain, that Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) was brought a man
who had picked an earring from the ear of a girl. He (peace be upon him) said: 'This is open snatching'. So he (peace be upon him) whipped him and imprisoned him.

key_terms.الدَّغَارَةُ: Open snatching or theft from a person

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic legal ruling for stealing an earring from a person's ear?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* illustrates Imam Ali’s (AS) judicial discretion in classifying theft from a person's body as 'open snatching' (*al-daghara al-mu'arana*), a category distinct from standard *hadd* theft, thereby warranting whipping and imprisonment. It highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on contextual legal reasoning (*ijtihad*) where the method of taking determines the specific penalty, reflecting the practical application of justice in early Islamic society.
